column1: # contracts/upstream-schema.sql, and the guard messages PostgreSQL emitted.
# Generated by scripts/build_upstream_schema.py — do not edit by hand.  Every
# statement-skip row is cross-checked against contracts/schema-deviations.tsv: a skip
# with no registered deviation there fails scripts/schema_drift.py, and so does a
# registered `apply-exception:` row with no skip here.
# category    extension-unavailable  this server lacks an extension the statement needs
#             unsupported-statement  PostgreSQL refused the statement for another reason
#             guard-notice           upstream wrapped the statement in DO ... EXCEPTION
#                                    and PostgreSQL reported the skip at runtime
# file/line    where the statement starts in the vendored file
# objects      the keys the skipped statement was going to create, kind:name — a
#              statement whose DDL could not be parsed is keyed `statement:<file>:<line>`
#              so that no skip can escape contracts/schema-deviations.tsv
